blockers.summary: Card semantic readiness is 256 active and 92 projection_only; monster, military, interaction and organization cannot be claimed executable.
The v04 catalog has 230 authored rank resources while v06 has 348 records; the sets and mechanics are not an interchangeable drop-in replacement.
CardPlaySubmissionRuntimeController and CardEffectRuntimeRouter still route by runtime shape and legacy kind.
Main still synthesizes monster and technique definitions and joins v06 monster cards to roster entries by localized player name.
ProductMarketRuntimeController and ProductIndustryCatalogResource contain the same 46 IDs in different order; changing authority can change RNG assignment.
Role identity is index plus localized name and full role definitions are stored in live players and formal save payloads.
Legacy monster instances may lack stable monster_family_id and behavior weights are split between MonsterCatalogV06 and MonsterRuntimeController.
No complete authoritative MilitaryUnitSemanticSpec exists; v06 military cards are correctly projection_only.
Facility HP, capacity, throughput and rent fields are mirrored between card payloads and v06 rules; rent_rate_profile is not executable authority.
The overall coordinator remains v0.4-gated while selected domain owners receive a directly preloaded v0.6 profile.
AI, player presentation and diagnostics still consume raw catalogs or flat fields instead of the three standard projections.
Financial card terms are appended after catalog lookup by runtime controllers and have no immutable semantic reference contract.
Organization cards are complete in v06 data but excluded from Alpha selection and remain projection_only; catalog availability cannot prove gameplay authority.
Save/replay must migrate identities and instance shape without changing the v3 envelope owner order or silently enabling old full-run resume.

atomic_cutover_and_deletion_order.step: Freeze fingerprints, source sets, deterministic product order, RNG draw counts, save fixtures and execution parity before changing any authority.
Land shared SemanticIdentity/Condition/Target/Operation/Visibility/Randomness contracts and validation, with no runtime route change.
Establish one immutable target authority per non-card domain: role IDs, monster and behavior IDs, product order, facility profiles, military profiles, weather specs and victory spec.
Compile v06 card machine definitions into CardSemanticSpec and RuleExecutionPlan at catalog initialization; projection_only remains fail closed.
Register existing domain transaction handlers by stable operation_id, preserving prepare/commit/rollback/finalize and RNG order.
Cut diagnostics, player presentation and AI to standard projections; require zero raw catalog fallback for migrated domains.
Migrate setup/session-start/save writes to stable IDs and instance state while retaining bounded legacy readers.
Cut over execution domain by domain: commodity/facility/supply-demand, interaction/counter, monster, military, finance/weather, role passives and victory.
In one atomic card entry cutover, remove runtime-shape v06/legacy branching, legacy requirement inference and flat-kind routing; require one typed submission path.
Delete Main monster synthesis and CardRuntimeDefinitionWorldBridge special sources after their production consumer counts reach zero.
Remove CardRuntimeCatalogService and the v04 catalog from production composition only after inventory, AI, UI, diagnostics, execution and save parity are green.

Remove the v0.4 composition gate only after every current v0.4-configured owner consumes the single session rules authority; retain frozen historical fixtures and fail-closed save inspection as policy requires.

conclusion.primary_duality: v0.4 session/card authority remains active while v0.6 domain catalogs and handlers are active in parallel
conclusion.immediate_next_boundary: semantic kernel and one-authority domain identity contracts before any legacy deletion
